name: Djamila Ribeiro
shortBio: Afro-Brazilian philosopher and public intellectual who synthesized Lélia Gonzalez, Sueli Carneiro, and Black feminist standpoint theory into the widely influential epistemology of Lugar de Fala (Standpoint).
centralQuestion: How does acknowledging one’s social locus of enunciation (lugar de fala) dismantle epistemic privilege and democratize speech?

keyWorks.title: Lugar de Fala (Where We Stand)
keyWorks.description: Philosophical exposition of Black feminist standpoint epistemology and critique of universalized white male speech.

keyWorks.title: Pequeno Manual Antirracista
keyWorks.description: Applies structural anti-racist philosophy to everyday institutions, history, and epistemic ethics in Brazil.
